name: smarthire
description: SmartHire – AI-Powered Intelligent Job Matching and Recruitment Portal

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); ['data-mock.js','ai-engine.js','app.js','styles.css'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f);}); console.log('✅ All production assets successfully packaged into dist!');"
